baseline_and_control.naive_control_match.reason: The raw control uses 21 sampled IC values with the same encoder architecture and 80,001 parameters as the structured model. BC variants likewise match at 80,451 parameters, and both controls have completed runs.

baseline_and_control.held_fixed_respecte.reason: The architectural interfaces are retained, but the reference loss computation is changed. Reference training sums separate 20,000-point batch means; submitted training replaces each sum with one global mean. For a 150-specification arm this replaces eight collocation, two IC, and one boundary batch means with one mean each, changing their relative contributions rather than applying a common rescaling.

core_result.joint_coeff_ic_generalizatio.reason: No nonlinear family establishes the required gains on both axes. Reaction improves unseen parameters by 0.019923 over raw inputs but slightly worsens unseen combinations (0.025222 versus 0.024885). RD, CDR, and CR worsen unseen-parameter means; their small combination gains are below δ=0.01.

core_result.unseen_ic_family_generalizat.reason: The required nonlinear-family tests were completed, but structured encoding is worse than raw inputs on Gaussian ICs: reaction 0.302634 versus 0.249831, RD 0.331478 versus 0.325521, CDR 0.318081 versus 0.300002, and CR 0.399930 versus 0.319870. The clear improvement occurs only on linear convection. The allowed values omit an evaluated-but-unsuccessful nonlinear core result: it is neither clear, positive-but-sub-δ marginal, nor absent. Adjudication is required.

core_result.seen_spec_preserved.reason: Seed-averaged canonical-IC errors violate the per-coefficient tolerance at all 9 trained RD coefficients and all 12 trained CDR coefficients. For RD μ=(0,1,1), error rises from 0.038228 to 0.098240: an increase of 0.060012 against an allowed 0.005. These are substantial regressions, not slight tolerance exceedances.

conditioning_attribution.beats_naive_con.reason: Head-to-head comparisons were run, but the nonlinear core contains both near-ties and losses, including noise-separated Gaussian-family losses of 0.052803 on reaction and 0.080060 on CR. conditioning_attribution.removed_conditi.reason: Held-out degradation exceeds seed noise. conditioning_attribution.non_degenerate.reason: Saved latent arrays directly distinguish the 62 probed ICs. generalization_boundary.failure_regime_m.reason: Narrower smooth Gaussian sources and moderately higher sinusoidal frequencies are meaningful specification queries. Even σ=π/12 spans about eleven grid intervals per standard deviation on the 256-point grid; the sweep is not a sub-grid or ill-posed construction, and substantial failure already occurs at σ=π/6.

generalization_boundary.fundamental_vs_u.reason: Substantial increases were executed: encoder width 150→512, epochs 20,000→40,000, and collocation 1,000→2,000, with failure persisting. The rubric explicitly requires the failing setting itself, so the full discrimination is incomplete.

generalization_boundary.failure_mechanis.reason: The paper attributes failure to IC frequencies leaving the M=10 feature band, but the executed frequency sweep contains only k=1…8, which are all retained.
